## Product

Bookly: web app where small clinics publish availability and patients book
appointments. Two languages (Spanish, English).

**Environment: not production.** The stack starts empty on every deploy;
there is no data to preserve between versions.

## Responsibilities

| Scope | Folder | Stack | Verify |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frontend` | `web/` | React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, i18next | `npm run typecheck && npm test` |
| `api` | `api/` | FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy | `pytest -q` |
| `db` | `db/init/` | PostgreSQL init SQL, numbered by load order | `pytest -q db/tests` |
| `infra` | `docker-compose.yaml`, `.github/` | Docker Compose, GitHub Actions | — |

## Sources of truth

- **Theme:** CSS variables in `web/src/styles/tokens.css`; components use
  tokens only, never fixed colours.
- **i18n:** `web/src/locales/{es,en}/`; every key in both languages.
- **UI primitives:** `web/src/components/ui/` (shadcn/ui).
- **API contract:** OpenAPI schema generated by the API; the web client types
  are generated from it, never written by hand.
- **Configuration:** `.env.example` documents every variable.

## Conventions

- Routers stay thin; queries live in `api/services/`.
- Commit descriptions in native user language.

## Data policy

Schema changes go only into the init SQL. No migrations, no `ALTER TABLE`.

## CI

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: one job per responsibility running its verify
  command on every pull request.
